annotations.title: Check who read a tracked link

description: Reports whether a tracked HTMLRadar link has been opened and how many read it. For each reader shown in full, it reports who they are, how long they read, how far they scrolled, and all recorded sections ordered by reading time. On Free, the first five readers of a link are shown in full; later readers appear as a "more read it" count. Reading times are rounded down; scroll percentages are rounded to the nearest whole percent. It accepts the link's share id, slug or full address. With `include_detail`, each reader shown in full has their country, city, device and referring page added.

include_detail.description: Also return each reader's country, city, device and referrer. Off by default; whether the document was read, and which parts, is answered without it.

share_id.description: The share id returned by share_html, or the share's slug (the part after /r/ in its link), or the link itself.

name: get_share_activity
title: Check who read a tracked link
